label: Yodeck
description: Read workspace, folder, playlist and screen metadata

operations.name: list_workspaces
operations.description: Verify the credential's selected workspace, then read one accessible workspace catalog page. This is resource access, not actor/account ownership.

operations.name: get_workspace
operations.description: Read the exact workspace witness configured in the credential; no workspace settings or working hours.

operations.name: list_folders
operations.description: Verify the selected workspace and filter folders with the documented workspace query; validate every returned parent.

operations.name: get_folder
operations.description: Verify an exact existing folder ID and its selected-workspace ancestry.

operations.name: list_playlists
operations.description: Read one playlist catalog page and locally keep the selected workspace. The published route has no workspace query; count and continuation describe the full catalog.

operations.name: get_playlist
operations.description: Verify an exact existing playlist ID and workspace ancestry. Playlist elements, media and thumbnails are omitted whole.

operations.name: list_screens
operations.description: Request subset=basic explicitly; only ID, UUID, online/registered/last_seen and exact workspace ID are returned. No expanded fallback.
